images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of aScrambleToolBenchevaluation episode. The agent is presented with a sequential curriculum ofNNtasks (top-left) but has no prior semantic knowledge of the available tool action space (top-right), where all system tools are obfuscated with generic identifiers (such asfn_efc8). To progress, the agent dynamically reasons, forms hypotheses, and probes commands in the stateful environment (bottom loop). For example, while attempting Task 1, the agent initially hypothesizes thatfn_d588reads files but receives an error. Recognizing the failure, it adapts and callsfn_32e7, uncovering a clue pointing to an environment variable. Using this newfound context, the agent queries the variable viafn_b2b9, successfully retrieving the required passcode. Upon submitting this passcode, the environment confirms Task 1 is complete. The agent then transitions into Task 2 in the same episode, immediately probing a new tool,fn_614f, to discover network interfaces.
